versions.changelog: - No user-facing feature or documentation changes.

Initial release of the troubleshooting-computer-issues skill.

- Provides a structured, platform-agnostic workflow for diagnosing and resolving software, configuration, installation, command line, network, or runtime issues.
- Introduces a clear classification system (Simple/Medium/Hard/Extreme) for issue complexity, with dynamic reclassification.
- Ensures all troubleshooting attempts are recorded in a standardized long-term memory format.
- Enforces strict verification rules before marking any issue as solved or unsolved.
- Includes direct links to diagnostic templates, solution memory format, and a common solutions index.
